Team,

Quick runbook for this week's submission — trying a tighter slotting approach to reduce last-minute churn. Action items in priority order: 

- Update stage flags in SFDC by EOD Wednesday (Closed - Commit / Commit - At Risk / Commit - Confirmed). Use the attached weekly-commit-template.xlsx.
- Attach evidence for any Commit-stage accounts: short artifact list in evidence-checklist.xlsx (PLC, SOC2 pointer, legal contact).
- If you anticipate a downward motion in the next 72h, mark as "Commit - At Risk" and add one-line rationale in the record.

Proposed 15-min sync today to lock slots and call owners: 11:30–11:45 PT. Agenda attached (call-agenda.pdf). Please confirm availability or propose 10:30 / 12:00.

Notes: We are asking AMs to own the evidence bundle upload. RevOps will validate links prior to submission. I assigned initial owners in the Drive folder (see link).

Olga
